name: Anthony
wiki_Spelling_and_pronunciation: The name was historically spelled Antony, as in William Shakespeare 's play Antony and Cleopatra . During the late 15th till 17th century, the letter "h" became more frequent in the spelling of the name on the notion that it originally derived from the Greek word ἄνθος ( anthos ), meaning "flower". In Britain, the historical pronunciation / ˈ æ n t ən i / predominates for both spellings, while in the United States the spelling pronunciation / ˈ æ n θ ən i / is more common when the "Anthony" spelling is used.
